quote: Termination for convenience is permitted by either party on 90 days' written notice.
policy_quote: We must be able to terminate for convenience with no more than 90 days' notice. Violation: termination requires >90 days, or termination for convenience is excluded.
reason: Convenience termination is allowed on 90 days, which meets 'no more than 90 days' and is not a listed violation. The same section also requires 120 days' notice of non-renewal; the policy does not cover non-renewal notice, so that term is noted and not scored.
